title: Kinsta Review (2026)
intro: Kinsta is evaluated here as IT & development software — Kinsta is managed WordPress (and adjacent app) hosting on Google Cloud — a hosting-providers peer of WP Engine and Cloudways, not a Plesk/cPanel panel licence. Single 20GB publishes from $35/month as the ongoing floor; promotional first-month offers appear on marketing pages and must not replace $35 as the research floor. Free migrations are commonly offered; there is no general free trial. WP Engine remains the cluster award (7.7); this entity does not outrank it. Landscape-only versus Plesk. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Kinsta when managed WordPress hosting is the job — not a Plesk/DirectAdmin panel licence, and not WP Engine by default.
verdict: Choose Kinsta when managed WordPress hosting is the job — not a Plesk/DirectAdmin panel licence, and not WP Engine by default. Compare WP Engine for WordPress-specialist managed hosting; Cloudways for managed multi-cloud VMs; Plesk only on landscape pages for panel licences. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.
